UN Report Links Al-Qaeda to Red Fort Bombing

A United Nations Security Council (UNSC) report has revealed that the Al-Qaeda in the Indian Subcontinent (AQIS) was responsible for a car bomb attack near Delhi's Red Fort. The report also noted AQIS's efforts to expand its network in Bangladesh and its use of artificial intelligence. Indian authorities expressed increased concern following the report's findings.
